root.label: Hegseth announces 20 percent cuts to senior military positions

events.label: Hegseth announces 20 percent cuts to senior military positions

slots.name: senior positions cut
slots.sentence: Hegseth announced plans to cut 20 percent of positions reserved for generals and admirals across the Army, Navy and Air Force — doubling an earlier 10 percent reduction.

slots.name: officers relieved
slots.sentence: There's a lot of questions that were raised about the 30 or so senior military officers that have already been relieved.

slots.name: past general officer reduction
slots.sentence: The personnel changes come a year after Hegseth oversaw a 10 percent reduction of general officers and after already firing or pushing out more than two dozen senior military officers across the service branches since taking over at the Pentagon — changes that have unnerved lawmakers in both parties.
